title: Coordenador de Projetos Marítimos (GIS)
description:
Sobre a empresa GIS

Seja em terra ou no mar, você encontra esse desafio na Edison Chouest Offshore . Somos uma família de empresas voltadas para resultados e apaixonadas pela excelência. Estamos orgulhosos do mosaico de pessoas que nos torna o fornecedor líder mundial de serviços marítimos.

GIS Energia e Construção (GISEC), uma divisão da GIS LLC com sede em Louisiana, EUA, é uma empresa do Grupo Edison Chouest Offshore que oferece soluções integradas para os mercados de petróleo, gás e energia no Brasil e na América do Sul. A GIS traz mais de 75 anos de experiência em serviços onshore e offshore , cobrindo todas as etapas: da fabricação ao descomissionamento.

Estamos construindo no Brasil um modelo de negócio confiável, ágil e com foco no cliente — com um portfólio completo e velocidade de entrega com segurança, qualidade e excelência.

Nossos serviços incluem:

• Manutenção de ativos, gestão de integridade, suporte a operações , gestão de paradas programadas, projetos e suporte ao descomissionamento para prestadores de serviços e operadores na indústria de Óleo e Gás/Energia;

• Manutenção e construção/suporte de infraestrutura para energias renováveis, incluindo solar e eólica;

• Inspeção, Manutenção e Reparo de ativos.

Quer se juntar a nós e fazer parte do time de GIS?

Descrição da vaga

A pessoa atuará como Coordenador de Projetos Marítimos, no Porto do Açú (RJ), na GIS Energia e Construção (GISEC).

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Identificar proativamente e buscar novos projetos com empresas de serviços marítimos e de ROV de dentro e fora do Grupo Chouest e que façam escalas no BPORT;
  • Fornecer estimativas de custo e cronograma de alta qualidade para aprovação do Cliente, desenvolver planos de execução para escopos multidisciplinares e/ou complexos, montar e gerenciar equipes com recursos adequados às necessidades do projeto;
  • Monitorar o desempenho e ajustar conforme necessário para manter uma entrega segura, confiável e rentável;
  • Concluir os projetos com a satisfação do Cliente e garantir a entrega e aprovação da documentação que respalde a aprovação da fatura;
  • Liderar a equipe de Serviços Marítimos no monitoramento e gerenciamento de todas as fases do trabalho para garantir que os requisitos de cronograma, custo/orçamento, técnico, qualidade e HSE sejam cumpridos ou superados;
  • Estabelecer um cronograma claramente definido para todas as fases do trabalho e manter o status atualizado;
  • Manter um histórico atualizado das evoluções de custo e planejamento ao longo do projeto, preparar justificativas para apoiar qualquer solicitação de alteração que impacte custo e cronograma;
  • Revisar e controlar os planos de execução do(s) subcontratado(s) para garantir conformidade com os requisitos contratuais, identificar ajustes necessários e garantir sua implementação;
  • Informar prontamente ao Gerente de Base Operacional sobre qualquer questão que represente uma ameaça significativa ao projeto e propor medidas mitigadoras;
  • Fornecer relatórios precisos e pontuais ao Gerente de Base Operacional e ao Cliente para evitar imprevistos nos projetos e garantir apoio contínuo;
  • Assegurar a coordenação em tempo hábil de recertificação com as sociedades de classificação após modificações ou reparos em sistemas certificados;
  • Monitorar e reportar KPIs, incluindo prazos de entrega do projeto, métricas de segurança, níveis de retrabalho e pesquisas de satisfação do cliente.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior em Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Registro ativo no CREA;
  • Certificações da Class, DNV, Bureau Veritas e/ou ABS em soldagem, inspeção e outros sistemas marítimos específicos.
  • Experiência anterior na área

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Conhecimento aprofundado na liderança de práticas de trabalho seguras em projetos de construção e/ou manutenção industrial;
  • Conhecimento de operações de manutenção de embarcações ou logística marítima;
  • Sólido conhecimento em operações e infraestrutura portuária e as exigências regulatórias brasileiras, serviços a embarcações , segurança do trabalho e manutenção de infraestrutura.

title: Líder Técnico III (Web/Mobile/Servidores)
description:
O Inatel está recrutando Especialista para atuar na liderança técnica de projetos de software, no ICC PDI SW.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Liderar tecnicamente projetos de desenvolvimento de software; propondo soluções que atendam ao negócio e sejam performáticas e flexíveis, considerando requisitos de escalabilidade, confiabilidade e desempenho das soluções integradas;
  • Realizar a especificação funcional de projetos, definindo e documentando arquitetura lógica e executável de sistemas;
  • Projetar software para integração e entrega contínua;
  • Prover solução e suporte para o desenvolvimento de funcionalidades de aplicações móveis, web e servidora;
  • Desenvolver aplicações de alto nível;
  • Realizar o planejamento e o monitoramento das atividades técnicas dos projetos.
  • Prover capacitação, orientação e suporte técnico aos desenvolvedores;
  • Revisar código desenvolvido conforme boas práticas da tecnologia;
  • Prover suporte ao time de QA;
  • Elaborar documentação técnica do projeto, operacionais e de apoio à gerência;
  • Garantir a qualidade e integridade dos artefatos técnicos desenvolvidos;
  • Desenvolver e manter padrões de codificação e documentação técnica, promovendo a adoção de novas tecnologias e metodologias;
  • Resolver problemas técnicos complexos e fornecer suporte técnico à equipe, removendo impedimentos e facilitando o progresso do trabalho.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em cursos da área de tecnologia como Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou Ciência da Computação;
  • Vivência na gestão de projetos ligados a tecnologias Mobile
  • Experiência em práticas de DevOps, incluindo Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD e monitoramento;
  • Proficiência em desenvolvimento de soluções Web, aplicações móveis e soluções em nuvem;
  • Domínio em banco de dados não relacional/relacional, Webservices, Design patterns, Modelagem de projetos, Ferramentas de análise de código e de controle de versionamento de código;
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis, especialmente Scrum, e ferramentas de gestão de projetos como JIRA;
  • Conhecimentos em testes automatizados e unitários e ferramentas de design UX/UI.

Informações adicionais

Horário de trabalho: Segunda a sexta, das 8h as 12h e das 13h30 as 17h30.

Local de trabalho : As atividades poderão ser realizadas em regime de Teletrabalho "Home Office".

title: Operador Produção C
description:
Na Agropalma, há muita coisa boa à sua espera. Então, se você é um profissional apaixonado por aprendizado e gosta de trabalhar em união, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Juntos, alcançaremos nosso objetivos.

Estamos com oportunidades para OPERADOR DE PRODUÇÃO C para a região de LIMEIRA/SÃO PAULO.

#VemSerAgropalma

Descrição Breve do Cargo:

- Preparar equipamentos para produção (setap/Limpeza);

- Operar equipamentos (envaze líquido/escamador/cristalização/robô);

- Controlar estoque de caixas, baldes e tambores;

- Manter ambiente de trabalho limpo e higiênico;

- Cumprir normas de segurança alimentar e saúde ocupacional;

- Realizar montagem de bag’s de 900 e 180kg

Instrução

  • Ensino Médio Completo;

Localidade

  • Limeira/SP
  • Americana/SP

Nossa Empresa

Somos a maior produtora de óleo sustentável da América Latina, reconhecida em todo o mundo pela qualidade superior de nossos produtos e processos, e pelo compromisso com o meio ambiente e as pessoas. Geramos cerca de 5mil empregos diretos e desenvolvemos projetos socioambientais que impactam direta e indiretamente na vida de todos.

Temos operações no Pará e em São Paulo. Nossos plantios e fábricas de extração ficam situados em Tailândia/PA, onde iniciamos nossa trajetória em 1982. Também possuíamos modernas refinarias nas cidades de Belém/PA e Limeira/SP. Especificamente, na unidade de Limeira, temos uma refinaria multióleos, com equipamentos de última geração e um Centro de Inovação pronto para atender às indústrias de panificação, sorvetes, confeitaria, food service, lácteos, cosméticos e produtos não alimentícios (químicos e oleoquímicos).

Mais do que desenvolver produtos de qualidade, nosso objetivo é cooperar para um mundo melhor. Tanto que dos nossos 107 mil hectares de terra, destinamos 64 mil a áreas de reservas florestais preservadas e monitoradas, com riquíssima biodiversidade. Em Tailândia/PA, mantemos agrovilas com completa infraestrutura para nossos colaboradores, com escola, clubes e academia.

#VemSerAgropalma

title: GESTOR DE BARTER
description:

title: Analista de Contas a Receber Pleno
description:

title: Engenheiro de Dados Pleno
description:
Somos Atvos!

Na Atvos, produzimos e comercializamos etanol, açúcar VHP e energia elétrica a partir da cana-de-açúcar e da biomassa. Nossa energia vai além do negócio: está nas pessoas e no nosso jeito de ser. Com capacidade para abastecer mais de 60 milhões de carros com etanol, adoçar milhões de festas com nosso açúcar e levar energia para o bem-estar de mais de 20 milhões de pessoas, também somos destaque na emissão de CBIOs. Atuamos com responsabilidade, desenvolvendo comunidades, cuidando do meio ambiente e transformando vidas. Aqui na Atvos lideramos a transição energética para mover o mundo e transformar vidas.

Confira mais da nossa empresa pelo site:

#VemPraAtvos

Aqui, diversidade é essencial! Nossas vagas são destinadas a todos, com incentivo á participação de mulheres e PCDs.

Descrição da vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados para atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução da nossa plataforma de dados, com foco em GCP, BigQuery e pipelines escaláveis. Essa pessoa será responsável por projetar arquiteturas de dados robustas, garantir governança e qualidade da informação e atuar de forma colaborativa com times de BI, Data Science e negócio, apoiando a tomada de decisão e a criação de soluções analíticas de alto impacto.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Projetar, construir e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis, confiáveis e eficientes, utilizando Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Desenvolver e evoluir a arquitetura de dados, incluindo camadas de ingestão, processamento e disponibilização para consumo analítico.
  • Atuar com BigQuery, Cloud Storage e Composer (Airflow) na orquestração e transformação de dados.
  • Implementar boas práticas de DataOps, engenharia de software e automação (versionamento, CI/CD).
  • Garantir a qualidade, segurança e governança dos dados, utilizando ferramentas como Data Catalog e Dataplex.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com times de Business Intelligence (BI), Data Science/MLOps e Automação (RPA), entendendo as necessidades do negócio e traduzindo-as em soluções de dados.
  • Monitorar a performance da plataforma de dados, propondo otimizações de custo e desempenho.
  • Apoiar a evolução da plataforma de dados para novos casos de uso.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Conhecimento em Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Domínio de SQL e experiência prática com BigQuery.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Python para processamento e automação de dados.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração de pipelines, como Airflow / Composer.
  • Conhecimento de conceitos de DataOps e boas práticas de engenharia de software (Git, CI/CD).
  • Vivência na construção de pipelines de dados end-to-end e camadas de acesso para usuários.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Databricks, Spark ou outras tecnologias de Big Data.
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de Machine Learning e MLOps.
  • Experiência prévia com arquitetura medalhão (bronze, silver, gold).

Informações adicionais:

Nosso modelo de trabalho é híbrido , com três dias presenciais por semana em nosso escritório em Pinheiros/SP. Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e conectado com o propósito de produzir energia limpa e renovável, impulsionando o futuro sustentável do país.

Benefícios que fortalecem nossa energia

Na Atvos, acreditamos que cuidar das pessoas é essencial para transformar o amanhã . Por isso, oferecemos um pacote de benefícios pensado para apoiar seu bem-estar, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida dentro e fora do campo ou do escritório.

Confira o que você encontra por aqui:

  • PLR anual , de acordo com seu desenvolvimento
  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica

title: Controller Sika Brazil
description:
Company Description Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the building sector and industrial manufacturing. Sika has subsidiaries in 102 countries around the world and, in over 400 factories, produces innovative technologies for customers worldwide. With more than 34,000 employees, the company generated sales of CHF 11.76 billion in 2024. It includes monitoring and controlling all economic transactions to guarantee proper administration of the company’s resources, while ensuring full compliance with applicable legislation, Sika Group policies, and best practices in financial management.   • Define the financial policy to be followed by the Company, in consultation and agreement with superiors.

  • Control compliance with tax and labor obligations.
  • Advise General Management on matters within their professional scope.
  • Train, promote, and motivate their staff.
  • Identify needs and develop the training plan for their area, submitting it to the HR Department.
  • Know, comply with, and help disseminate the policies of the Integrated Management System, regarding Quality Management, Occupational Health and Safety, and Responsible Environmental Care of the Company.
Qualifications Educational and Attitudinal Competencies
  • Formal education: Degree in Administration, Economics, or Public Accounting. Preferably with postgraduate training in Administration or equivalent.
  • MBA, specialized in finance, or other postgraduate studies relevant to the role.
  • Special courses: Proficiency in PC and operating systems. Financial updates. Knowledge of ISO 9001 and 14001 standards. Knowledge of accounting standards (GAAP).
  • Advanced English
  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years in similar positions in medium or large companies.
  • Strong critical, reflective, and analytical capacity.
  • High level of concentration, speed, and accuracy in mathematical calculations.
  • Quick and confident decision-making.
  • Good interpersonal skills. Firm and responsible character.
  • Willingness to travel nationally and internationally on a regular basis.

title: Teaching Intern
description:
Intern, Primary Division (Pedagogy, Licenciatura, Physical Education, Arts)

About Avenues

Avenues is one school with many campuses, providing transformative, world-focused learning experiences to students around the globe. Avenues prepares students for engaged global citizenship during a time of unprecedented complexity and accelerating change, combining a global curriculum based on language immersion and interdisciplinary learning with a culture of creativity and deep collaboration.

About the Role

Deep Collaboration, Constant Evolution

Collaboration here isn't a buzzword: it's woven into everything we do. At Avenues, no one teaches on an island. Substantial time to collaborate is embedded into the schedule. Teacher teams, across multiple disciplines, design learning experiences together for a whole grade level. This intensity of collaboration is challenging as well as exciting: we're always evolving, learning from each other and seeking to improve.

The Avenues Intern Program (A.I.P) is a two-year on-site teacher preparation program that offers early career educators the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a Primary Division language immersion setting for them to follow a path in any school setting. Interns collaborate closely with grade-level colleagues in all aspects of classroom life and beyond. In addition to their classroom work, interns will participate in bi-weekly meetings where they explore issues essential to primary education and discuss how these issues are playing out in our classrooms. These meetings also offer interns the opportunity to share and reflect upon their experiences, thereby gaining new perspectives. In your role, you will:

  • Support class and specialist teachers to develop and teach engaging, creative curriculum and lessons, aligned with Avenues expectations and approach
  • Support the day-to-day functioning of the class and school
  • Collaborate closely with a team of teachers responsible for classes of students
  • Participate actively in ongoing professional learning

About You

  • Desire to learn early childhood and elementary teaching foundations and best practices in an immersion setting
  • Deep dedication to learning and developing the craft of teaching
  • Superb ability to collaborate with colleagues to achieve goals
  • Currently studying toward a teaching degree in a Brazilian university, either in primary education ( pedagogia) or another subject ( licenciatura )

Additional Information

Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.

Avenues upholds the highest standards for safeguarding the physical and emotional wellbeing of children. As an essential aspect of this commitment, all offers are contingent upon successful completion of careful reference and background checks.

description:

description:

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. O Diretor lidera com visão e integridade, construindo uma cultura escolar segura, inclusiva e colaborativa onde o aprendizado prospera. title: Release Manager
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.

Job Summary

The Software Release Manager II will plan, coordinate, ensure notifications are sent in a timely manner, and schedule software releases in alignment with organizational strategy and goals. This role works closely with cross-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle to ensure the quality and timeliness of releases , monitor and report progress during the release windows, and identify areas for improvement through testing feedback. The position also develops reports and metrics to communicate release performance to leadership.

Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate, communicate, schedule, and facilitate software releases to meet business objectives.
  • Collaborate with development, QA, operations, and change management teams to ensure readiness and quality.
  • Monitor and communicate release progress, identify risks, and escalate issues as needed.
  • Facilitate release meetings and maintain release calendars.
  • Review testing outcomes and work with QA to address defects and improvement opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain release documentation, including release notes and rollback plans.
  • Produce reports and metrics on release performance and communicate findings to leadership.
  • Ensure compliance with InComm’s release management policies and best practices.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives for release processes.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field preferred.
  • 4+ years of experience in release coordination, change management, or related IT governance roles.
  • Familiarity with SDLC processes and testing practices.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills; ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Experience with tools such as JIRA, Confluence, ServiceNow, or similar for tracking and documentation.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
  • Understanding of release governance, risk management, and quality assurance principles.
  • Analytical skills to interpret metrics and identify process improvements.
  • Comfortable working in Agile or iterative development environments.

Benefits

R$340 home office allowance

️ R$1,150 meal/food allowance (VR/VA)

10% annual bonus

Sul América health/dental plan

title: Senior Manager of Campus Facilities & Procurement
description:
Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.

Job Description

The Senior Manager of Campus Facilities & Procurement is responsible for overseeing and managing the physical infrastructure, facilities, maintenance, construction, health and safety, and procurement functions at Avenues São Paulo . This role ensures a safe, compliant, and operationally efficient environment across all back-office and heavy-duty areas, supporting the school’s mission and daily operations.

Main responsibilities:

  • Ensure campus facilities align with Avenues' standards regarding safety, efficiency, and brand consistency.
  • Oversee the campus's expansion and summer construction, ensuring readiness at the start of each academic year.
  • Ensure compliance with local, state, federal, and accreditor regulations regarding infrastructure and health and safety.
  • Optimize vendor relations for services such as construction, facilities maintenance, and procurement.
  • Manage and streamline procurement processes (national and international), ensuring the campus receives quality resources at the best price, including contracts management and legal compliance.
  • Implement and maintain an efficient work-order management system to address maintenance and repair needs according to the SLA.
  • Manage budgets and financial resources efficiently.
  • Provides monthly KPIs dashboards for the department, including this area, Client Service and Experience, Finance and Security.
  • Ensure high-quality service delivery by implementing an efficient work order system that streamlines requests, tracks progress, and ensures timely resolution. Continuously monitor performance, address challenges proactively, and optimize processes to enhance both operational efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction.
  • Oversee service contracts with third-party partners, aligning teams to deliver excellent service while maintaining strong partnerships and fostering vendor development to meet our needs and expectations.
  • Collaborate closely with the Senior Manager of Campus Experience as needed to ensure a seamless and positive campus environment.

Qualifications

  • Solid experience in operations management and/or school leadership, preferably in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (written and spoken).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or a related field, or equivalent professional experience; postgraduate degree is a plus.
  • Demonstrated knowledge and experience in areas including legal and regulatory compliance, risk management, vendor management, construction oversight, environmental health and safety, indoor air quality, and procurement.
  • Proven ability to manage complex projects, organize multiple workstreams, and design scalable processes and KPIs.
  • Strong sourcing and procurement skills, with the ability to identify needs and efficiently purchase goods and services.
  • Experience prioritizing and overseeing maintenance and repair activities through an effective work-order management system.
  • Comfortable operating in environments with ambiguity and change; intellectually curious, adaptable, and quick to learn.
  • Proactive and solutions-oriented, with a track record of initiating and improving ideas, practices, and operational approaches.
  • Able to communicate openly and constructively, speaking candidly and making difficult decisions with empathy, professionalism, and collegiality.
  • Forward-thinking mindset with an appreciation for leveraging technology to enhance learning environments and operational effectiveness.

Additional Information

Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.

Avenues upholds the highest standards for safeguarding the physical and emotional wellbeing of children. As an essential aspect of this commitment, all offers are contingent upon successful completion of careful reference and background checks.

title: Aprendiz
description:
Somos apaixonados pelo que fazemos e juntos conduzimos um negócio com mais de 30 anos de história.

Já ultrapassamos a marca de 120 lojas, entre próprias e franquias, além de + 1.100 multimarcas que vendem nossos produtos por todo o país e um e-commerce potente que oferece uma infinidade de itens que atendem o lifestyle masculino.

Hoje temos um orgulho enorme de dizer que a #NossaComunidade está presente em todos os estados do Brasil e isso é só o começo. Em 2024 faturamos mais de 670 milhões de reais e caminhamos com o objetivo de dobrar de tamanho até 2026 e atingirmos a marca de 1 bilhão de reais.

E vale dizer que estamos em plena expansão e como parte da nossa estratégia de crescimento decidimos iniciar uma jornada para nos tornarmos uma house of brands , prática comum no varejo de moda.

E como marco em nossa história lançamos em 2022 a nossa nova marca Urban Performance , que mescla elegância e praticidade para entregar ao homem mais conforto nos diferentes ambientes que ele ocupa em sua vida como lazer, esporte e trabalho. Em 2025 lançamos a Aramis Next , onde reafirmamos nosso compromisso de acompanhar essa trajetória desde os primeiros passos do cliente, construindo um legado para a próxima geração de clientes e para os próximos 30 anos.

Para que tudo isso aconteça, contamos com mais de mil pessoas talentosas, que com protagonismo, colaboração, respeito e muito pertencimento, nos ajudam a construir o que em breve será o destino #1 do lifestyle dos homens .

Aqui, acreditamos que cada pessoa inspira uma a outra e juntos podemos impulsionar e transformar histórias. Colaborando uns com os outros, avançamos com leveza e inteligência.

title: Senior Property Manager
description:

  • Strong background in U.S. residential and/or commercial property management (required)

title: IT Operations Manager
description:
We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.Our Core Focuses:End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.

Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the comprehensive operation and maintenance management of IT infrastructure (including but not limited to servers, networks, storage, and related software platforms) within large-scale operational environments in the Americas region.

2. Develop and implement IT operation strategies, procedures, and standards (SOPs) to ensure the efficient, stable, and secure operation of IT systems, in compliance with internal and external regulations.

3. Manage the IT operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, team development, and daily management, to enhance team professionalism and efficiency.

4. Lead IT incident management, event response, change management, and problem-solving processes to ensure high availability and business continuity of IT systems.

5. Drive the IT operations' transformation towards automation and intelligence, introducing advanced technologies and tools to continuously optimize operational processes, efficiency, and quality.

6. Responsible for IT infrastructure capacity planning, performance monitoring, and optimization to ensure resource allocation meets business growth demands.

7. Manage IT-related vendors and third-party service providers, ensuring their service quality and SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance.

8. Responsible for IT operations budget planning, cost control, and analysis of technology investment returns.

9. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., Facilities, Asset Management, Security, Business Units) to ensure IT operations effectively support overall business objectives.

10. Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies, supporting the evolution of IT architecture to enhance technological competitiveness.

Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Electronic Information Engineering, or a related IT professional field.

2. Over 5 years of experience in large-scale IT system operation and maintenance management, with at least 3 years in a team management role; experience in multinational corporations is a plus.

3. In-depth understanding and practical experience with server hardware, operating systems (Linux/Windows), network technologies (TCP/IP, routing & switching), and storage systems.

4. Familiar with ITIL/ITSM management frameworks, possessing excellent capabilities in ITIL process implementation and optimization.

5. Practical experience with IT automation and intelligent operation tools (e.g., scripting languages, monitoring systems, configuration management tools).

6. Excellent team leadership, project management, and risk management capabilities.

7. Outstanding communication, coordination, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, capable of handling complex technical and managerial issues.

8. Strong English reading, writing, and communication skills, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

9. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications such as ITIL, PMP, CCIE/CCNP, RHCE are a plus.

10. (Plus) Experience in cloud platform operations or DevOps practices is a plus.

title: Analista de dados
description:
OPORTUNIDADE DE PARCERIA (PJ) Em Analista de Dados Pl

Formada e liderada por professores do Departamento de Engenharia de Produção da Escola Politécnica da Universidade de São Paulo (Poli-USP), a Fundação Vanzolini é uma organização sem fins lucrativos, que traduz o conhecimento acadêmico em ações de impacto.

Há quase 60 anos, a Fundação desenvolve, aplica e dissemina novos conhecimentos da Engenharia no cotidiano de pessoas, empresas, organizações e governos, contribuindo na resolução de problemas econômicos, ambientais, técnicos e sociais no Brasil e no exterior.

Fundamentada em um olhar sistêmico, integrador e multidisciplinar da Engenharia de Produção, a atuação da Fundação se destaca também no desenvolvimento de projetos voltados ao setor público, especialmente nas áreas de Educação e Gestão.

Escopo de Atuação

Atuar de forma estratégica no levantamento de requisitos, tratamento, integração, análise e visualização de dados, apoiando decisões e a padronização de indicadores educacionais. Terá atuação direta na construção de pipelines de dados, manutenção de dashboards e inteligência analítica aplicada aos projetos da EFAPE.

Principais responsabilidades:

Entender, de forma proativa, as necessidades dos setores da EFAPE, realizando reuniões autônomas para levantamento de requisitos;

Desenvolver processos de ETL/ELT utilizando Python e SQL;

Publicar e manter dashboards analíticos no Power BI;

Documentar processos e garantir qualidade, confiabilidade e padronização dos dados;

Apoiar a qualificação de pesquisas de opinião junto à rede estadual;

Contribuir para a padronização de indicadores educacionais;

Realizar análises exploratórias e geração de insights;

Atuar em integração técnica, confiabilidade e inteligência de dados.

Competências Desejadas

Formação superior em Tecnologia, Engenharia, Estatística ou áreas correlatas;

Experiência como Analista de Dados;

Domínio de Python e SQL para manipulação e análise de dados;

Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados como Power BI, Tableau e/ou Qlik Sense;

Vivência prática com automação de processos, criação de fluxos e projetos de dados;

Boa comunicação e atuação em projetos multidisciplinares.

Diferenciais

Experiência no setor público;

Conhecimento em Databricks;

Noções de LGPD e Lei de Acesso à Informação;

Boas práticas de segurança de dados.

Características de Perfil Esperadas

Perfil analítico, com capacidade de resolver desafios complexos e contribuir para projetos inovadores;

Autonomia para identificação e resolução de ocorrências junto aos demais setores;

Proatividade e comprometimento para alcançar metas;

Flexibilidade para atuar em diferentes projetos e demandas;

Organização e atenção aos detalhes;

Senso de dono e urgência;

Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e se comunicar com diferentes áreas;

Interesse em aprendizado contínuo e atualização técnica.

PJ 

Presencial

title: Product Sales Executive - AI
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a motivated AI Product Sales Executive to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for understanding our AI products and their market landscape, and supporting sales and marketing initiatives. You will play a crucial role in communicating with customers, providing training, and ensuring successful product deployment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Knowledge and Strategy Development

  • Gain a comprehensive understanding of our AI products, including their selling points, market positioning, and competitor strategies.
  • Assist in the formulation of market strategies and the creation of promotional materials for designated regions.

2. Market Research

  • Conduct thorough market research within assigned regions, focusing on clinical workflows, competitor features, market pricing, and business models.

3. Customer Communication and Sales Support

  • Engage with customers to understand their needs and provide tailored product recommendations.
  • Collaborate with the sales team to prepare bid documents for tenders and achieve sales targets.

4. Marketing Activities and Presentations

  • Support various marketing initiatives by creating relevant materials based on customer and medical expert requirements.
  • Conduct professional presentations to effectively communicate product benefits.

5. Training and Development

  • Provide product training to users, including on-site training sessions.
  • Regularly conduct internal and external training for team members.

6. Product Deployment Coordination

  • Coordinate and support the deployment of software products to users, developing and implementing effective deployment plans.
  • Evaluate deployment results and provide timely feedback for continuous improvement.

7. Customer Relationship Management

  • Assist in maintaining strong customer relationships by effectively resolving on-site technical issues.
  • Analyze and organize customer needs to promote product usage.

8. User Feedback and Product Iteration

  • Collect and relay user issues to the development team to assist in product iteration and enhancement.

Qualifications

1. Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Biomedical Engineering, Medical Imaging, Clinical Medicine, Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

2. Experience

  • Previous work experience in medical imaging, medical devices, or healthcare information systems is preferred.

3. Skills

  • Excellent communication skills with a strong sense of responsibility and self-motivation.
  • Strong logical analysis and problem-solving abilities.
  • Proficiency in using Office software for product and data presentations.

4. Travel

  • Willingness and ability to travel as required (over 50% of time)

title: Cientista de dados
description:
No Banco Safra, a Inteligência Artificial é um pilar estratégico que impulsiona a transformação digital com foco em eficiência, inovação e geração de valor. Integrada aos processos críticos do banco, a IA atua de forma coordenada com as áreas de negócio para apoiar decisões com base em dados e tecnologia de ponta.

Dentro dessa estrutura, a prática de Ciência de Dados tem papel central. Com atuação transversal, essa frente é responsável por organizar, estruturar e interpretar dados para gerar visibilidade estratégica e apoiar a tomada de decisão em diversas áreas de negócio. A equipe é composta por perfis especializados — como cientistas de dados, engenheiros de dados e profissionais de ML Ops — que combinam profundidade técnica com visão de negócio.

Responsabilidades:

Estamos em busca de Cientistas de Dados para integrar nossa Squad dedicada à construção de modelos preditivos, descritivos e diagnósticos voltados para diversas áreas de negócio soluções analíticas voltadas para diversas áreas estratégicas. O profissional atuará em projetos de alto impacto, desde o diagnóstico até a modelagem preditiva, com foco em gerar valor para o negócio por meio de dados.

Principais responsabilidades:

- Desenvolver e implementar modelos estatísticos e de machine learning.

- Traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções analíticas.

- Trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados estruturados e não estruturados.

- Colaborar com áreas de negócio e engenharia de dados.

- Monitorar e manter modelos em produção (MLOps).

- Participar da definição de KPIs e processos da Squad.

- Atuar com autonomia e protagonismo em entregas estratégicas.

Requisitos Indispensáveis:

- Linguagens: Python (avançado), SQL (avançado).

- Bibliotecas: Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch.

- Plataformas: Cloudera, Spark, Hive.

- MLOps: Deploy, monitoramento e manutenção de modelos.

- Modelagem estatística: regressões, árvores de decisão, boosting, clustering.

- Feature engineering e avaliação de modelos.

- Machine learning

- ETL em camada de negócios

- Visualização de dados e storytelling analítico

Desejáveis:

- Conhecimento em NoSQL.

- Experiência com notebooks Jupyter.

- Ferramentas de visualização: Power BI, Tableau.

- Experiência com sistemas de recomendação e séries temporais.

title: Sr. Technical Customer Success Analyst
description:
Title: Sr. Customer Support Analyst

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Location: Brazil, Remote

Graphic Communications( a CAI Division) is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for print industries. Graphic Communications ’s integrated and automated software offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With several offices worldwide, and over thirty-years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the printing industries, it is our deeply held philosophy that Graphic Communications succeeds when our customers thrive. For more information, visit us at

As a Sr. Customer Support Analyst , you will troubleshoot complex customer requests, manage the global support queue and backlog, and ensure exceptional, timely service for our valued customers. Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager, Customer Success , you will play a crucial role in driving customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise, analytical thinking, and customer-focused mindset to deliver high-quality solutions to critical support issues. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, collaborating closely with internal teams to diagnose, resolve, and prevent recurring issues.

Your key responsibilities include delivering specialized technical solutions to escalated support cases, providing a proactive, personalized customer experience, and strengthening the partnership between the Customer Support Team and Graphic Communication’s clients through technical excellence and accountability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Answer incoming telephone calls and open cases in Salesforce, identifying customers, populating case details, and confirming data accuracy.
  • Monitor the Global Support queue and accept Salesforce cases in priority sequence.
  • Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact.
  • Troubleshoot customer-reported issues, identify root causes, and provide timely solutions via case updates, calls, or screen-sharing sessions.
  • Provide customer support via email, Teams, and telephone using discretion, experience, and technical judgment.
  • Escalate or re-route cases to appropriate Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams after thorough investigation while maintaining SLA compliance.
  • Allocate resources, systems, and solutions to ensure efficient issue resolution.
  • Identify customers’ operational and business challenges, guiding them and the Graphic Communications team toward effective resolutions.
  • Document and submit solutions to the knowledge base with complete technical and procedural details.
  • Close cases with accurate and comprehensive resolution documentation.
  • Collaborate closely with R&D and Services teams to replicate and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Test, analyze, organize, and report progress on ongoing customer cases.
  • Ensure accountability and progress tracking through Salesforce reporting and analytics.
  • Manage and prioritize active support cases within your queue while maintaining strong communication with customers.
  • Make informed case routing decisions, escalating appropriately based on technical complexity.
  • Follow up with clients on outstanding queries and provide proactive updates.
  • Notify clients about new software releases, coordinating with Marketing to ensure customers are informed of relevant fixes and improvements.
  • Collaborate with Tiered Support peers and Development teams for environment setup, database capture, and other technical tasks as required.

Technical Troubleshooting Responsibilities

  • Use Chrome Developer Tools (Inspector) to analyze web applications, review network requests, debug front-end issues, and identify JavaScript or API failures.
  • Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman or cURL.
  • Conduct IIS and SSL diagnostics to investigate and resolve issues on Windows Application Servers.
  • Configure and troubleshoot Windows ADFS Servers and perform remote diagnostics via VPN, RDP, or similar tools.
  • Assist customers with database backups, migrations, and SQL troubleshooting using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), write scripts, stored procedures, and queries.
  • Utilize network tracing tools (e.g., Wireshark, Fiddler) to diagnose connectivity, latency, or certificate-related issues.
  • Perform log analysis across web, application, and system logs to identify root causes of performance or access issues.
  • Understanding of web deployment and troubleshooting for ASP.NET-based applications and related components.
  • Maintain proficiency in analyzing browser console errors, network calls, and response payloads to pinpoint issues in customer environments.
  • Participate in proactive system health checks, monitoring server performance metrics and application uptime indicators.

Experience Requirements

  • Minimum 8+ years of customer support experience.
  • ERP/MIS background preferred.
  • Print industry knowledge is mandatory.
  • Experience with tools such as Salesforce, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.
  • Strong understanding of support operations and troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Ability to solve problems efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work with minimal guidance.
  • Confident in delegating tasks and providing peer guidance.
  • Willing to work in shifts as required.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Strong documentation and organizational abilities.
  • Data analysis skills (reports, dashboards, and metrics).
  • Proficient in general computing, internet research, and email communication.
  • Understanding of web development, SSO, Active Directory, and SSL.
  • Hands-on experience with VPN configuration, network management, and SQL scripting.

Education

  • Degree in Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience in customer support and enterprise systems.
  • Strong understanding of software troubleshooting, printing workflows, and IT infrastructure preferred.

title: Content Labeler / Moderator (Portuguese)
description:
Project Background(Toxic Words Labeling)

This project focuses on cleaning and annotating in-game voice content, with an emphasis on identifying sensitive language such as violent expressions and profanity. The resulting training data will help better distinguish ambiguous content and support overall content safety and user experience improvement.

Responsibilities

  1. Download the audio to your local computer through the audio link for playback.
  2. Determine whether the audio contains toxic words. If so, mark "Toxic" in the "Is toxic" column of the table. If the audio does not contain toxic words, mark "Normal"
  3. For words containing toxic, mark each time point of the toxic word in the "Note" column (if a word is repeated multiple times, the time point of each occurrence must be marked) and the toxic word, and its corresponding English translation
  4. List the 20 English translations of the most frequently occurring dirty words (it is not necessary to collect 20, as many as possible)

Requirements

  1. Native Portuguese based in Brazil, fluent in both spoken and written English (minimum B2 English level)
  2. Available 30-40 hours per week with relatively fixed daily schedule
  3. Up-to-date PC (Windows 10 or later) or Mac (Big Sur or later) with stable utility and internet connection
  4. Degree and/or working experience in literature, translation, linguistics, teaching is a plus
  5. Similar project experience in data collection, annotation, quality control, coordination is a plus

Training & Payment

  1. Each participant will attend approximately 1 hour of training
  2. Actual work will be paid based on completed cases.
  3. Estimated time per case is about 1 minute, based on internal testing.

Additional Notes

  1. The project is expected to run for approximately 3–4 weeks. Please ensure that you are able to remain available for the full project duration and meet the output targets as defined by the Project Manager.
  2. Once you confirm participation in this project, early withdrawal during the project period is not permitted

title: Clinical Trainer LATAM
description:
About Lumenis

Lumenis is a world leader in laser- and light-based technologies for medical and aesthetic applications. Ever since introducing the first medical laser system in the world nearly 45 years ago, Lumenis has been at the forefront of technological innovation and market leadership in its segment. Today, Lumenis offers a wide range of products, an unparalleled technical support system, the largest global installed-base of medical laser products and one of the largest investments in research and development in the industry. Lumenis has installed more than 60,000 medical systems in doctors’ offices, clinics and operating rooms in more than 75 countries around the world. The company has over 100 FDA clearances; more than 250 registered patents & patent applications; and a team of 900 employees that work in synergy worldwide. Further, Lumenis is a truly an international organization, with direct business offices in strategic locations around the world, including the United States, UK, Germany, Israel, China, Hong Kong, India, Japan and Australia.

About the role:

As a Clinical trainer, reporting to the Clinical Training Director, you will be responsible for the development and deployment of clinical training for Lumenis customers, distributors and field employees. This position also involves overseeing every detail of training logistics to guarantee smooth and successful training sessions.

Main Duties:

  • Collaborate closely with the Clinical Training Director to implement and uphold rigorous high quality standards in training
  • Provide clinical training to existing and potential customers (digital and onsite).
  • Provide clinical training to existing and potential distributors’-affiliated clinical trainers and follow-them up
  • Coordinate all local clinical events.
  • Demonstrate use/ benefits of Lumenis products to the customers.
  • Proactive involvement with the new changing needs of digital engagement.
  • Ensure that all training programs meet the required regulations and standards.
  • Innovate the current educational offering for salesforce and customers to a digital platform.
  • contribute to the global effort in producing collaterals such as but not limited to blog, newsletter, application notes etc

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience or training in the medical device industry; preferable experience in the aesthetics field - an advantage.
  • Experience in preparing and adjusting clinical presentations as per audience and allocated time.
  • Accurate in delivering training messaging.
  • Excellent presentation skills.
  • Must be willing to travel throughout LATAM region – around 70%. and exceptionally outer LATAM
  • Interpersonal skills and professional demeanor.
  • Results- driven and self-motivated.
  • Highly organized and detail oriented.
  • Able to work independently.
  • Cooperate with others, teamwork.
  • Enthusiastic about gaining new knowledge and dedicated to self-improvement by regular engagement in professional development activities (such as but not limited to gathering clinical updates from scientific journals)
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills in English. Knowledge of Spanish and/or Portuguese will be considered an advantage

title: FPA Manager
description:
Key Responsibilities

  1. Financial System Establishment
  • Take ownership of building the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) function for the Brazilian subsidiary from the ground up, including budgeting, forecasting models, management reporting, and financial analysis processes.
  • Design financial management systems that comply with local regulatory requirements and group standards, ensuring data alignment with headquarters.
  1. Business Decision Support
  • Actively participate in business planning for the Brazilian market, providing financial modeling and risk assessment for new market entry, product pricing, channel investment, etc.
  • Monitor core business metrics (e.g., revenue, gross margin, cash flow), promptly identify anomalies, and drive corrective actions.
  1. Budgeting and Forecasting
  • Lead the annual budgeting and quarterly rolling forecast processes for the Brazilian subsidiary, track performance against forecasts, analyze variances, and propose optimization measures.
  • Develop flexible forecasting models to support rapid business experimentation and dynamic adjustments.
  1. Business Analysis and Reporting
  • Prepare and submit regular business performance analysis reports on Brazilian operations to headquarters, using data to drive strategy review and iteration.
  • Build localized financial dashboards to enhance business teams' understanding and utilization of financial data.
  1. Cross-functional Collaboration and Localization
  • Assist the group finance team in the initial setup of local systems for tax and treasury in Brazil, liaising with external parties like local accounting firms and banks.
  • Support business teams in contract reviews, investment evaluations, etc., ensuring activities adhere to financial governance.

Qualifications & Requirements

  1. Basic Background
  • Bachelor's degree or above in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related fields. Professional certifications such as CPA, CMA are preferred.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), with at least 2 years working in/on the Brazilian market and familiarity with local financial compliance.
  • Prior experience in building financial systems from scratch (e.g., in a startup or during overseas branch establishment) is highly advantageous.
  1. Professional Competencies
  • Proficient in financial modeling, budgeting, and business analysis tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, SQL).
  • Solid knowledge of Brazilian tax codes, accounting standards (BR GAAP), and multinational financial reporting processes.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to quickly grasp business logic and translate it into financial management frameworks.
  1. Soft Skills
  • Excellent cross-cultural communication skills. Fluency in English or Portuguese is required for work; Mandarin Chinese proficiency is a strong plus.
  • Adaptable to an entrepreneurial environment, demonstrating strong problem-solving initiative and resilience under pressure.
  • Skilled in coordinating resources from various stakeholders and balancing requirements between headquarters and local needs.

  • Apoiar no análise de dados e desenvolver modelos estatísticos para apoiar decisões estratégicas.

Você vai ser a pessoa responsável por organizar a esteira de marketing e vendas , coordenar o time (interno e parceiros) e garantir que cada entrega aconteça no prazo, páginas, criativos, e-mails, automações, tráfego, webinars/aulas, checkout e pós-venda, e atinja os objetivos pré-definidos.

  • Acompanhar KPIs do projeto e do funil (ex.: leads, show-up, conversão, CAC/CPA, ROAS, churn etc.) para orientar prioridades.

  • Experiência real coordenando lançamentos e/ou operações de perpétuo .
  • Organização e execução fortes: você sabe cobrar, negociar prazo e fazer acontecer.
  • Domínio de uma ferramenta de gestão (ClickUp).
  • Boa comunicação com diferentes perfis (criativo, tráfego, tech, vendas e atendimento).
  • Capacidade de criar briefings claros e controlar qualidade antes de ir pro ar.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com GHL / ActiveCampaign / Make (ou ferramentas similares de CRM/automação).
  • Experiência com páginas/checkout e integrações (WordPress, Shopify, Hotmart, Eduzz, Kiwify etc.).
  • Familiaridade com tráfego pago (Meta/Google) e tracking (Pixel/CAPI/UTM/GA4).
  • Vivência com squads remotos e parceiros (copy, designer, editor, dev, gestor de tráfego).

O que você vai coordenar (exemplos)

  • E-mail marketing, WhatsApp, automações e segmentações
  • Criativos, vídeos, copies, VSL/aulas, webinars e materiais
  • Rotina de tráfego, orçamento, calendário de campanhas e testes
  • Pós-venda: onboarding, entrega, retenção e melhorias

Contratação

title: Sales Manager
description:
Aware, a global leader in biometric identification software products, solutions, and services, is seeking a Sales Manager for our LATAM Civil & Criminal Identity business unit. Reporting to the VP of LATAM, this role is responsible for the development, planning, management, and execution of sales activities for two industry-leading products in this sector.

The Sales Manager will develop deep expertise in these products to clearly articulate their value propositions and to deliver and/or support technical presentations and product demonstrations for customers and partners.

Essential Job Functions

  • Execute sales plans with the objective of exceeding revenue, gross margin, and other key financial performance metrics
  • Generate and qualify leads, converting them into well-defined sales opportunities
  • Effectively manage and follow up on market-qualified leads to drive pipeline growth
  • Establish and maintain key partnerships within the territory to expand market presence and drive incremental revenue
  • Support targeted law enforcement accounts within the territory in alignment with Public Sector sales strategies and plans
  • Support trade shows and industry events to develop new opportunities and revenue
  • Utilize CRM and other sales tools to maintain accurate and up-to-date records on customer interactions, activities, forecasts, and sales opportunities

Qualifications and Experience

  • 5+ years of experience selling software solutions to law enforcement agencies or public sector agencies
  • Deep understanding of the LATAM public safety ecosystem, including procurement processes, regulatory environments, budget cycles, and political/cultural nuances
  • Familiarity with the political, cultural, and operational nuances of selling to law enforcement and public-sector institutions across the region 
  • Proven experience developing and closing business in some of the following countries: Mexico, Colombia, Peru, Chile, and Argentina, with a clear understanding of local decision-making structures, procurement models, and compliance requirements. 
  • Ability to adapt sales strategies to country-specific market conditions while maintaining regional alignment.
  • Direct experience selling, implementing, or supporting automated biometric identification systems (ABIS), facial recognition, fingerprint, or multimodal biometric solutions in public safety or criminal investigation contexts. This includes understanding investigative workflows, evidentiary requirements, system accuracy considerations, and the ethical and regulatory implications of biometric technologies.
  • Existing network of integrators, system vendors, consultants, and channel partners operating in the public safety and law enforcement space is highly desirable. 
  • Experience working through partners to position, bid, and deliver complex solutions, as well as the ability to activate and manage partner relationships to drive pipeline and revenue.
  • Strong technical acumen with the ability to understand unique customer requirements and learn new technologies.
  • Understanding of biometric technologies and underlying data science.
  • Proven ability to combine sales acumen with technical knowledge to deliver effective presentations and demonstrations
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Spanish and Portuguese
